visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of two hands pulling apart a golden, crusted pineapple bun, revealing a dense, stretchy layer of yellow melted cheese inside. The background is blurred. (2) A hand uses a wooden brush to apply a thick yellow egg wash onto rows of pale, round unbaked dough pieces. (3) A pair of hands in short sleeves slides a metal tray filled with white dough balls into a large, heated industrial oven. (4) A metal rack holds several trays of freshly baked pineapple buns with their characteristic golden-brown, cracked sugar crusts. (5) A hand holds a pineapple bun wrapped in paper, showing a thick slice of cold butter melting inside. (6) Close-up of a hand breaking open a bun to show the soft white interior and the crunchy top. (7) Hands pull apart another bun with a thick, stringy cheese filling that stretches significantly across the frame. (8) A bun is presented filled with a large piece of seared pork chop, green lettuce, and a fried egg. (9) A close-up of a bun containing a dark brown, glistening piece of chicken thigh with tomato slices. (10) A bun is shown with a dark chocolate spread and a slice of butter. (11) A person's hands pour dark reddish-brown tea from a tall metal pot through a long white cloth filter bag. (12) Close-ups of various iced drinks in paper cups, including a creamy milk tea being poured over ice and a lemon tea with floating slices. (13) The video ends with a shot of the restaurant's menu board and the storefront decorated with traditional Hong Kong-style signage and red chairs.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我們最近在高雄. (2) [Subtitle]: 吃到一間港式菠蘿包. (3) [Subtitle]: 味道比想像中還喜歡. (4) [Subtitle]: 老闆娘說麵包. (5) [Subtitle]: 是每天烘焙製作的. (6) [Subtitle]: 一天準備的量其實不多. (7) [Subtitle]: 點餐後會再烤一下. (8) [Subtitle]: 吃起來香酥蓬鬆. (9) [Subtitle]: 配上奶油是甜中帶鹹. (10) [Subtitle]: 如果喜歡起司的. (11) [Subtitle]: 可以選他們比較濃的. (12) [Subtitle]: 牽絲菠蘿包. (13) [Subtitle]: 風味會更厚一點. (14) [Subtitle]: 起司感也比較明顯. (15) [Subtitle]: 鹹口味的豬扒也蠻多人點. (16) [Subtitle]: 有先醃過. (17) [Subtitle]: 味道比較有層次. (18) [Subtitle]: 會搭配煎蛋. (19) [Subtitle]: 還會配生菜或番茄. (20) [Subtitle]: 雞扒的肉感會更飽滿. (21) [Subtitle]: 咬起來也蠻紮實的. (22) [Subtitle]: 還有一款苦甜巧克力. (23) [Subtitle]: 是加脆片的組合. (24) [Subtitle]: 他們家也有手沖的. (25) [Subtitle]: 港式茶飲. (26) [Subtitle]: 像是絲襪奶茶. (27) [Subtitle]: 鴛鴦奶茶. (28) [Subtitle]: 或是酸甜的凍檸茶. (29) [Subtitle]: 最近想吃菠蘿包的話. (30) [Subtitle]: 可以試試看. (31) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. (32) [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉. (33) [Logo]: 黑白淡奶. (34) [Slogan]: 香江港式菠蘿茶飲 楠梓店. [Slogan]: 高雄市楠梓區翠屏路49號.
